notes.title: achievement fix + drumsel clicker update + english support
notes.content: Now achievements giver will work properly and we finnaly added english support to drumsel clicker!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31859210/39f6da1bd32921bd6e93af2c52b374f2e883b5b4.png[/img]

notes.title: UI Update
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31859210/b99a36247f3ff60d1fc52ac54dad0ab64c6780a7.png[/img][h1]Changes:[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Mission control window now displays which application you should open, instead of "ChangeTask".
    [*]We reworked the mining system - now it properly calculates income based on components installed.
    [*]Mining interface has been reworked.
    [*]Bug, which prevented components from being displayed in mining setup window.
    [*]We added an option to disable and enable plugins in store.
    [*]Now, you can check how much coins you have, by moving the mouse cursor to the top right corner of the desktop.
[/list]

notes.title: Dynamic Update
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31859210/43ac03f9346fe1761c30ee39b8457c432659d28a.png[/img]
[h1]Changes:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Plugins now have their own preview.
[*]Gravity, CMD and Maze mini-games now are more difficult, dynamic and engaging;
[*]Dialog system now has been changed - dialogs no longer disappear after a set duration of time, now the player has to skip them manually, using space bar.
[*]Hints no longer disappear after a set duration of time - now they stay on screen until dialog ends.
[*]If bordering horizontal tile in Maze is blocked, the game starts with the player moving downwards.
[/list]
[h1]Fixes:[/h1]
[list]
[*]We managed to fix a bug, which prevented coins from being given to the player.
[*]BattleHack and Мatrix no longer freeze.
[/list]

notes.title: Plugin update!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31859210/d969ed25936bda790486b03f7b5863152f4f6d70.png[/img]
We have received your feedback and were able to address some issues, which you reported to us:
- New features have been added to the game.
- Many bugs have been fixed.
- A lot of new themes and wallpapers have been added.
- Plugins, which enhance mini-games are now in the game.
